summary: Frontend-only E2E test of SoleasPay V3 success UI flow with route-mocked /initiate and /status. Registered a fresh test user (testsoleas1), logged in, selected mode-soleas, filled the form, submitted, intercepted both endpoints to return {status:'paid', activation_done:true, level:1}. The activated success view renders correctly (testID 'soleas-activated', green check, French heading '🎉 Mon compte est activé !', level number, CTA 'Accéder à mon espace (Xs)', countdown text 'Redirection automatique dans X seconde…') and the countdown decrements 3→2→1. HOWEVER the automatic redirect to /services does NOT occur: the parent's onActivated callback fires window.alert() BEFORE window.location.href, which blocks JS execution until the user dismisses the modal alert. In Playwright with default dialog handling the URL stayed on /activation; only if a dialog handler accepts the alert does navigation proceed. This contradicts the requested 'automatic redirect after 3 seconds' UX.

integration_issues.issue: window.alert('✅ Paiement confirmé ! Votre niveau est activé.') in the onActivated callback (activation.tsx line 623) is a BLOCKING synchronous modal that halts JS execution before window.location.href='/services' (line 624) runs. Result: the auto-redirect after the 3-second countdown is blocked until the user clicks OK on the alert. Same issue if the user clicks the 'Accéder à mon espace' CTA manually. The new success card already provides clear visual confirmation (green check, '🎉 Mon compte est activé !', level info), so the alert is redundant AND breaks the requested auto-redirect UX.

action_items: Remove the window.alert('✅ Paiement confirmé ! Votre niveau est activé.') call in /app/frontend/app/(app)/activation.tsx line 623 inside the SoleasPollingView onActivated prop. The new in-page success card already shows the confirmation. Keep only `window.location.href = '/services'` (or better: use expo-router `router.replace('/services')`). This will allow the automatic 3s redirect to function as designed.
Consider replacing window.location.href with router.replace('/services') from useRouter() so the navigation works consistently across web/native and avoids a full page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: activation.tsx line 622-625: window.alert() blocks the auto-redirect — must be removed for the new success UX to work.

activation.tsx uses window.location.href instead of expo-router's router.replace — works on web only, may cause full reload and loss of in-memory auth token cache (rehydrated via storage so functional, but slower UX).

SoleasPollingView (line 951+) — countdown effect re-runs whenever onActivated reference changes; the parent inline function literal passed each render creates a new reference, but works here because countdown state guards the call. Acceptable.
activation.tsx is 1133 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting SoleasPollingView, AutoForm, ManualForm, CryptoForm into separate files.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: activation.tsx line 622-625 — the onActivated callback executes `window.alert(...)` synchronously before `window.location.href='/services'`. window.alert is a blocking modal on web; navigation is queued but the alert pauses the event loop. In automated tests without a dialog handler the alert sits forever; for real users the redirect only happens after they click OK. Since the new success UI design (lines 1007-1045) already shows a clear visual confirmation card with countdown + CTA, the alert is redundant. MITIGATION: delete the `window.alert(...)` line. Optionally migrate to `router.replace('/services')` from useRouter(). REPRO STEPS: 1) login as fresh user; 2) navigate /activation; 3) intercept the two soleaspay endpoints; 4) submit form; 5) observe success card with countdown decrementing 3→2→1; 6) at t≈3s observe browser alert appears AND URL stays on /activation until alert is dismissed.
